d: Are you the kind of person who walks into a warehouse and sees precision, rhythm, and potential? Do you love making things work smoother, faster, and better with a team that thrives on excellence?

We’re on the lookout for a seasoned, sharp-thinking Operations Supervisor to take the helm of our warehouse and logistics operations. You’ll be the engine that powers inbound, outbound, inventory, and last-mile operations delivering exceptional service to our customers and excellence across the board.
q: Education: Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Logistics, Business, or a related field.
Experience: 5+ years leading operations in warehouse or logistics environments, with teams of 50+.
Industry Edge: E-commerce or retail logistics experience is a major plus.
Tech-Savvy: Fluent in WMS, ERP systems, Excel, and Google Workspace.
Languages: English fluency a must. Arabic? Even better.
Skills That Make You Stand Out
Leadership that motivates and gets results.
A cool head under pressure with top-tier problem-solving skills.
Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach.
Obsessed with accuracy, timelines, and optimizing workflows.

At Boutiqaat, you won’t just join a company you’ll join a movement redefining e-commerce beauty and lifestyle retail. Here, every day offers new challenges, learning opportunities, and a chance to help build a smarter, more efficient operation from the ground up.
Kickstart your career with hands-on experience, expert mentorship, and real impact.
Apply now and be part of something exciting!
r: Own the flow: Oversee the entire lifecycle of goods from dock to doorstep, ensuring timelines, quality, and customer satisfaction are never compromised.
Lead like a pro: Inspire, train, and manage a team of warehouse associates, packers, and drivers, driving performance and productivity every day.
Master the numbers: Monitor KPIs, inventory counts, and SLAs with laser-sharp focus. You know every item has a place and every process has a purpose.
Collaborate across the board: From Purchasing to Finance to Customer Service, you’re the operational linchpin ensuring everything ticks.
Problem-solve like a ninja: Whether it’s a late delivery, a damaged item, or a stock discrepancy, you act fast and fix smart.
Supervise Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs), inspect product quality, and manage returns with vendors.
Ensure accurate stock entry using FIFO/FEFO standards and track discrepancies.
Drive timely and accurate order fulfillment—pick, pack, and ship like a boss.
Coordinate logistics to meet delivery SLAs and solve fulfillment hiccups quickly.
Lead cycle counts, audits, and reconcile stock movements.
Manage reordering, stock aging, and proper disposal of unsellable goods.
Route drivers for maximum efficiency and customer happiness.
Handle returns and delivery exceptions with professionalism and poise.
Schedule and coach staff for peak performance.
Implement continuous improvement strategies across operations.
